goal: Bind existing non-overlapping verification evidence to the final sealed CCC-299 candidate without rerunning passed work, and decide whether the producer contract is fully verified.

chain.purpose: participant P3 envelope caller, current seed registration caller and exact generated parity manifest
preview seed harness installation mode and off/off policy initialization

evidenceComposition: Central on 4a: generated semantic parity 1/1; 60 unaffected targeted API tests plus 15 participant-P3 cases passed; intake routes 7/7 passed; API typecheck passed; encrypted SQLite/PostgreSQL lifecycle matrix matched; non-update migration/database parity 2/2 passed with byte-stable generated parity; DB and core import guards passed.

The only six targeted API failures on 4a were the stale participant-P3 envelope. On 4d, the full participant-P3 file passed 21/21, including all six former failures and all fifteen prior passes. ae does not change that file or its producer dependencies.

The only corrected lifecycle smoke source failure on 4a was runScenario's stale registration call. 4d cut that caller to current gateway program/consent/registration seams. ae initialized the existing preview harness. On ae, direct createCaptureHarness plus full, unreduced runScenario passed 1/1 with 100 participants, 550 sessions, 600 consent events, 5 registry entries, a ready financial-support program, off/off policy unchanged, no preview output and disposable cleanup.
4d copied the generated parity bytes exactly; ae does not change migrations, parity or lifecycle code. 4a central parity and two-database evidence therefore remains bound by identical blobs.

Initial smoke path and missing SEED_PROFILE failures were harness invocation errors, each corrected and separately recorded. Mini Colima failure was an environment blocker replaced by central MacBook Docker proof; no claim relies on the broken mini runtime.
requiredReview: Verify every artifact hash and completion scope.
Fetch the final commit object read-only with --no-write-fetch-head. Verify chain parents, final tree and exact per-commit changed paths.

Compare final candidate blobs to the exact evidence-bearing commits. Lifecycle/migration/core/test blobs from 4a must remain unchanged except the declared 4d files; participant P3, scenario and parity must equal 4d; harness and preload must equal ae result hashes.
Verify final mini worktree is clean and no product file changed after ae. Do not switch/reset/modify the worktree.

Confirm every original central failure has a passing replacement on the exact final blob and every unaffected passing result still has identical dependencies. Do not count harness-invocation failures as source failures.
If coverage is complete, mark candidateVerified true and readyForConsumerHandoff true. Otherwise identify the exact uncovered behavior or changed blob.
constraints: Read-only except the final result JSON in controller artifacts.
Do not rerun tests, builds, seed scenario, Docker, migrations or guards; the task is evidence binding, not duplicate validation.
No product/worktree/branch/ticket/remote mutation, deployment, provider, credential or external service use.
